document.title: Lender's statement of interest on a passenger vehicle loan
document.issued_by: the lender on a loan to buy a passenger vehicle

boxes.label: the name and address of the individual from whom the interest was received
the date of origination of such loan
boxes.note: Schedule 1-A's first requirement is a loan originated after December 31, 2024; this date is the evidence.

boxes.label: the amount of outstanding principal on the specified passenger vehicle loan as of the beginning of such calendar year

document.notes: There is no IRS information return for 2025: Notice 2025-57 lets a lender furnish its own statement. The two boxes are the two things Schedule 1-A line 22 asks for, in its own words — the VIN and the interest for the loan. KIND, CITED: Notice 2025-57 section 3 lets a lender 'satisfy the reporting obligations under section 6050AA' for 2025 'by making a statement available to the individual' - so this statement IS the section 6050AA payee statement for 2025, which is why it is declared an information return rather than a taxpayer record. Section 6050AA(b) names what the return carries: the borrower, the interest, the outstanding principal at the beginning of the year, the date of origination and the vehicle's year, make, model and VIN - declared below; a 2025 statement may carry only the interest.
